_comment: Copy to a project root as .agent-system.json and commit it. delegate.mjs reads
it whenever --dir points here, so dispatches into this repo behave the same on
every machine without re-typing the routing. This is plain JSON (no comments in
the real file except this _comment array, which delegate.mjs strips).
Every field is optional. Precedence: explicit CLI flag > this file > built-in.
model             '<id>'           pin one model, skip rotation (e.g. 'glm-5.2')
template          '<name>'         templates/<name>.md to compose the prompt from
scope             ['glob', ...]    default allowed paths; ** any depth, * one seg
seed              ['path', ...]    files always attached up front
anti              ['line', ...]    baseline prohibitions; --anti on the CLI adds
to these rather than replacing them
includeUnverified true             let unbenchmarked models into rotation
keepStrays        true             do NOT auto-revert out-of-scope edits
This file is NOT read by opencode as an instruction source — it is dispatcher
config only. Project instructions for the delegate still go in AGENTS.md.
anti: never modify README.md, CHANGELOG.md, or CONTRIBUTING.md
do not touch lockfiles or CI config unless the task names them
